title: Spanish Flatbread Jewel Tacos
description: A delicious flatbread taco recipe filled with flavorful jewel-toned ingredients. Perfect for a quick and easy lunch or dinner!
instructions: Roll out flatbread to 1/4 inch thickness and cut into taco shapes.
Bake flatbread for 10-12 minutes or until crispy.
Prepare Jewel-Toned Pepper Salsa by combining diced peppers, onion, cilantro, and lime juice.
Prepare Spanish-Style Shredded Chicken by cooking chicken breast with olive oil, garlic, and cumin.
Assemble tacos by placing a spoonful of chicken onto each flatbread and topping with salsa, cucumber, and feta cheese (if using).
